An illustration of Isaiah's vision in the temple. At the top, a glowing, exalted throne with the hem of a majestic robe flowing down to fill a stone temple space. On either side, a six-winged seraph hovering in the air, using two wings to cover its face and two to cover its feet. At the bottom, a terrified Isaiah kneeling on the floor, holding his hands out in awe as thick smoke rolls around the temple pillars.

An illustration of the prophet Ezekiel receiving his call. A hand descends from a glowing cloud at the top, holding out an ancient rolled-up parchment scroll with Hebrew-like writing visible on both the inside and outside. Ezekiel, dressed as a Jewish captive in Babylon, is reaching up with open mouth to eat the scroll. Inset circle: a honeycomb, representing the sweet taste of the scroll.
